broker_bar_timestamp_detail: MT5 copy_rates_from_pos / copy_rates_range return the bar OPEN time in SERVER time. The timestamp is the start of the M5 interval, not the close.
canonical_signal_timestamp_detail: The sealed research CSVs (GBPAUD_M5.csv / GBPNZD_M5.csv / AUDNZD_PRO_M5.csv) carry the raw MT5 open-time timestamps and the sealed pipeline applies the session rule est_hour=(hour-5)%24 DIRECTLY to them. R2 preserves this verbatim; the strategy key is the raw open time.
close_time_conversion: bar_close_time = bar_open_time + 300s, used ONLY for freshness/age math. The strategy key is NOT shifted to close time (shifting would break session classification and the sealed 194/405 parity).
strategy_snapshot_key: canonical bar OPEN time (raw MT5 server time)

evidence.session_boundary_tests: 02:55 EST=2 (outside), 03:00 EST=3 (open), 11:55 EST=11, 12:00 EST=12 (hard exit), 12:05 EST=12 (after) — fixed UTC-5, no DST
